author: Joaquín Gamonal
short: Hermes-backed casual chatter with guild-scoped memory
description: A Red-DiscordBot community cog. The Red cog owns Discord behavior and Hindsight memory; a separate Hermes profile behind a loopback OpenAI-compatible API supplies the agent.
install_msg: Install the gamoaicog package with `[p]cog install GamoAI gamoaicog`, set the cog environment variables in Red's service environment, then `[p]load gamoaicog`.
